title: XpAwardedPayload
description: A durable, already-decided XP reward derived from one source completion.

repeat_index.description: Optional. Prior eligible completions of the same lesson when the amount was decided (N). Absent on awards stored before M6.

completion_kind.description: Optional. Kind of the rewarded completion; absent means lesson. review and remediation never decay.

withheld_reason.description: Optional. Why the XP was decided as 0: scripted_farming_hold (src/abuse/xp_hold.py) or below_pass_mark (src/state_machine/pass_mark.py). Absent on normal awards.

occurred_at.description: Optional. Time of the completion, set only on a below_pass_mark award, which has no LessonCompleted event to take the time from. Absent on normal awards.
